fire: The recipe needs 3 eggs and a cup of flour.
Our flight leaves at 7 in the morning.

She ran the race in 41 minutes.
The box holds 250 sheets of paper.

quiet: The recipe needs three eggs and a cup of flour.

The museum opened in the twenties after years of delay.

notes: Probe: ' ' before digits 0.38-0.55 in four frames; digits after '(', '#' or '=' read 0.00. Read the near misses as numbers in words or digits with no space token before them.
